experiment: widen test (standalone, not an engine integration)

marks.rule: contributing (drop > +2 paired SE) -> useful, genes frozen at mutation rate 0

settings.seed_rule: rounds seed family advanced one step past round 2 (20261400/20261401); each arm freshly initialises run/draw RNGs from these seeds; the preservation gate's representative draw uses arm draw seed + 999 (the runner's cfg.draw_seed + 999 protocol)
settings.freeze_rule: units whose silencing drop clears the paired-noise band upward (contributing) are marked useful; their genes mutate at rate 0 in both phases (mask applied over the class prob vector)
settings.classes_rule: arm C: be._base_classes(layout, 0) (prune-graft continuation classes). Arms A/B: the transplant's own classes from be.make_transplant

scaling.exempt_definition: subject units marked useful whose original genes all survive the transplant intact at their gene-map positions with exact original values

shortlist_agreement.tracker: bert_archive.UsefulnessTracker driven from the evolution loop (runner hook placement)
shortlist_agreement.unit_aggregation: mean of per-weight log-scores over the unit's genes (new layout)
shortlist_agreement.shortlist_rule: bottom 50% of units by aggregated usefulness
